name: Matterhorn
summary: Terminal client for Mattermost team chat, with channels, threads, search and attachments
description: Matterhorn is a full-featured terminal client for the Mattermost chat server. It supports multiple teams, channels and direct messages, threads, message editing and reactions, search, attachments, URL opening, theming and Vim-style or Emacs-style keybindings. Versions track the Mattermost server version they are tested against.
